comparison: PolishEvaluationTests.normalize (trim; CRLF to LF; runs of newlines and the spaces around them to one LF), then exact match against any accepted string; separately, no forbidden substring (text of the reference context) may appear

cases.note: Remove topic bridges when dictating at the caret; keep the earlier sentence out of the output.
cases.before: 第一段介绍了果园。入口处有一棵梨树。
cases.transcript: 嗯然后第二点是水渠在哪儿，然后我们就沿着水渠种芦苇。
accepted: 第二点是水渠在哪儿，我们就沿着水渠种芦苇。

cases.note: Use the casing of a term introduced in context without copying the earlier sentence.
cases.before: 果园图册把矮梨树品种记作 StarPear，每行都有独立编号。
cases.transcript: 嗯然后 star pear 要种在沙土里，每排留两米。
accepted: StarPear 要种在沙土里，每排留两米。

cases.note: Preserve the two topics; a paragraph break at the change of topic is optional.
cases.before: 去年只试种了两排，秋天才收获。
cases.transcript: 呃所以今年要多留一块地，等春天整平。嗯工具箱里可以放铅笔和尺子。
accepted: 所以今年要多留一块地，等春天整平。工具箱里可以放铅笔和尺子。
